tbesh_html:
1) to look out or about, spy, keep watch, observe, watch
1a)(Qal) to keep watch, spy
1b) (Piel) to watch, watch closely

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance; by implication, to observe, await
strongs_1890.kjv_def: behold, espy, look up (well), wait for, (keep the) watch(-man).
